title: Registered ForwardOpen with bounded connection path
purpose: Reach the Connection Manager ForwardOpen parser after session registration while supplying a complete bounded request whose path and trailing fields are useful mutation anchors.
expected_behavior: The server should parse the registered session and either process the bounded ForwardOpen request or return a deterministic protocol response without reading beyond the declared CPF data item.
constraints_preserved: Both messages use 24-byte EtherNet/IP encapsulation headers.
Encapsulation payload lengths are little-endian and match the payload byte count.
The second message reuses the registered session handle.
CPF contains a Null item followed by a UCMM data item.
The connection path length is bounded by the supplied path bytes.
issue_safety_notes: This preserves the issue-relevant ForwardOpen and connection-path structure as a safe analogue. It intentionally avoids the documented underflow pattern and exact historical bytes; model-prior ForwardOpen field semantics are not externally verified.
